slides.headline: 591K people roasted this footballer's new tattoo
IT LOOKS LIKE A ROBOT DREW IT
slides.body: A viral tweet by @VladitoByke called the tattoo "AI art style": that hyper-smooth, shiny look AI image generators produce, permanently on skin. The post hit 564,690 views in 28 hours. Cucurella posted the tattoo himself on Instagram on July 28: "Promise fulfilled"

slides.headline: THEY COMPARED IT TO $10 STREET CARICATURES
slides.body: One reply said the tattoo looks like those quick drawings street artists sell on city sidewalks for $10. Another said pro footballers are "so weird when it comes to tattoos." @MadridXtra shared the post and spread it even further

slides.headline: YOUR CUSTOMERS HAVE THE SAME EYE
slides.body: 564K people spotted AI style on skin in 28 hours. That same eye judges your website, your ads, your emails. The businesses winning use AI to work faster behind the scenes, not as the finished product

slides.headline: THE TATTOO ISN'T COMING OFF
slides.body: But the roasting keeps going. Follow and watch it play out. Send this to the friend who would 100% get this tattoo
